title: 공식 모델 상수 민감도·선택 규칙 교차 확인
nature: sensitivity audit; not new validation; official model/constants are NOT changed or reselected whatever the result

inputs.retraining: none for grid and swap; train-normal current re-read from CSV via 01_scores.frame_rows only to recompute r2_ref; E3 refits v2 per window via 04.fit_split exactly as official 13_r2_oos_alpha.py

grid.R2_Q_role: r2_ref = nanquantile(train-normal prefix R2, R2_Q); same r2_ref used for R1 release (wave_ok) and R2 hold
grid.R2_MIN_LEN_role: prefix R2 defined from row R2_MIN_LEN of each record (earlier rows NaN -> no release, no hold); applied to cached table prefix_r2 column and to the train prefix R2 for r2_ref

metrics.test_realtime: evalcore.evaluate(table, cand, alpha, 'test', r2_ref)['realtime']: tp, fp (normal false-alarm rows), fn (missed rows), f1
metrics.test_normal_fp_records: number of test normal records (A 120, B 180) with >=1 real-time alarm row (evalcore.predict_rows)
metrics.test_abnormal_records_detected: number of the 11 test abnormal records with >=1 real-time alarm row
metrics.valid_realtime: evalcore.evaluate(..., 'valid', r2_ref)['realtime'] f1 per split and mean over A/B
metrics.test_only: 07_r1_on_baselines.test_only (abnormal stream starts at test records); module PRIMARY_ALPHA patched to alpha; f1 and fn

summaries.distribution: min/median/max over 81 grid points per variant x alpha x metric x split
summaries.share_f1_ge_0.99: share of grid points with F1 >= 0.99 for A, for B, for both
summaries.fp_record_changes: number of grid points whose test normal FP records differ from the official grid point (per split x variant)
summaries.influence_oat: 8 one-at-a-time points from the official point
summaries.influence_main_effect: for each constant: mean metric at each level over the other 27 points; main effect = max - min; ranked for stage1/stage2 test F1 (A/B mean), test normal FP records (A+B), valid F1 mean

swap_cross_evaluation.roles: abnormal records 10..20 (11) = valid, 0..9 (10) = test; normal splits unchanged
swap_cross_evaluation.selection: official 02_select_on_valid.main run unchanged with CACHE/OUT redirected to temp dirs; same candidates/complexity, alpha 1%, TIE 0.002
swap_cross_evaluation.control: same redirected run on unswapped tables must reproduce official tvt_valid.csv and selection
swap_cross_evaluation.test: evalcore.evaluate(..., 'test') on front-10 for all candidates and alphas
swap_cross_evaluation.report: selected realtime and record models; selected model front-10 test F1 A/B; v2+H1, v2+H1+H2, v2 front-10 F1
swap_cross_evaluation.caveat: same single event reused with roles swapped; not independent

e3_optional.windows: rolling end in (180,240,300,360,420): train < end, cal end..end+119, eval end+120..end+179 (pooled 300 normal records)
e3_optional.metrics: normal alerted records for v2, v2+R2, v2+R1, v2+R1+R2 per grid point and alpha, pooled all 300 and keep 288 (excluding 302-304, 422-424, 460-462, 569-571)
e3_optional.control: official constants must reproduce 13 A_per_fold all|/keep| counts for rolling windows

verification: official constants reproduce tvt_test.csv / tvt_valid.csv (copy and claude/ versions) for v2, v2+H1, v2+H1+H2, alpha 1/3/5%, A/B, realtime and record: ints exact, F1 within 1e-12
test_only F1 at alpha 1% equals tvt_r1_baselines.csv for v2+H1 and v2+H1+H2
prefix_r2 recomputed at R2_MIN_LEN 8 equals cached column incl. NaN positions; r2_ref at (0.005, 8) equals tvt_scores_meta.json
patch visibility: function identity/globals checks; GAP_S=-1 or CONFIRM_ROWS=1e9 makes stage1 equal v2; NaN prefix length equals R2_MIN_LEN-1; test_only normal FP rows equal evaluate at patched alpha
cache SHA-256 equals copy tvt_selection.json inputs.rows_sha256; record environment versions and imported source hashes
if reproduction fails, grid results are not reported as official-code results
interpretation_rules: write 'all 81 grid points F1 >= 0.99' only if true for both A and B; otherwise report share and the constant conditions of failing points
write 'independent of a constant' only if the metric is identical across its levels for every combination of the other constants; otherwise report range
every statement carries: same single event; constants chosen after viewing data; grid is sensitivity, not new validation
no official model/constant/alpha change and no 'optimal constant' proposal based on these results
